name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(target_picked_up) hard matches the ban on taking the box from the other room. Response(has_door_key, door_open) soft matches holding the key with the door open then or afterwards, since 'try to' is a preference cue. Absence(key_lost) soft matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed', because key_lost is a key drop with the door not open. No goal is commanded, so the rule-only warning is valid, and no clause is added or missing.
